task.instruction: Check which email needs action as the highest-priority unread email. Refresh the mailbox, then reply to it.

generic_plan.plan: 1. Refresh the mailbox to get the latest email state. 2. After refresh, identify the highest-priority unread email (highest priority number among emails with status 'unread' and actionable=true). 3. Reply to that email.
important_facts: The goal is to reply to the highest-priority unread actionable email
Priority is determined by the highest priority numeric value among unread emails
Mailbox must be refreshed before identifying and replying
The environment will refresh before the final action, so email IDs/priorities may change—must re-evaluate after refresh
Only emails with status 'unread' and actionable=true are candidates
Previously EM-104 (priority 91) was the highest-priority unread email, but this may change after refresh
